start.npcText: You can look at the ledger if you want. Nobody looks at the ledger. It's the only interesting thing in this shop and it's under the lamp oil.

the_ledger.npcText: There. Every carter, every price, four years back — and see this column? That's what they SAID they'd charge next time. Two of them have never once matched it. Ma says that's business. I say that's a habit with a name on it.

responses.text: Keep that column. It'll be worth something one day.
